scope: Complete main paper matrix for all six local and six API judges; five frozen backbones, ten datasets. Activation neighbours only.

local.reuse: All main, 2NN, five ablation pairs, three mechanism annotators and both flip-focused reasoning orders preserved. No repeat of capped, invalid or ambiguous attempts.

api.alias_policy: Exact provider IDs must be resolved by external agent, never guessed or silently substituted.
api.main: 150000 calls for each new model only
api.reasoning: Each models own fixed50 valid unambiguous original test flips; both probability-first explanation256 tokens and explanation-first512 tokens; select new model flips only after its main run. Preserve old 7122 selections. Do not regenerate an already attempted old export.

integrity: Exact frozen tasks/texts/weights/splits/references; all raw responses, per-batch attempts written durably before dispatch; no automatic retry of attempted or ambiguous requests; no hidden exclusion; finite/input/hash checks; no numerical agreement gate;20GiB reserve; tasks independently logged and failed tasks never rerun automatically.
analysis: Primary fixed50/50 and validation-only common threshold pairs anchored in each original explanation condition with averaged paired deltas. New ablations matched. Mechanism associations include unchanged outcomes. Reason traces outcome-selected and not full-test F1; record answer availability. Expressed explanations are not private internal reasoning.
not_in_scope: Semantic retrieval, fresh-sample and constructed-pilot followups remain supplementary; no expansion of those conditions; do not restore previously paused runs.
